title: CheckStuckJobsToDbJobs
description: The parameters of the Scan of the DynamoDB jobs table that check-stale-jobs makes to find unfinished jobs created before a cutoff: it keeps the rows whose status is one of statuses and whose created_at is less than created_before, and follows every page.

statuses.description: The statuses a job can still move on from.

created_before.description: Unix seconds; only jobs created before this are returned.
